{{Top|leg}}
A '''mineral spotter'''<ref name="Survey">{{WEGCite|story=A Typical Survey|book=Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts}}</ref> or '''mineral sensor''' was a [[scanner]] designed to detect [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]].The [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[Multi-Environment Mining Droid MEMD-2]] utilized mineral sensors to detect mineral deposits for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> They were also used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to perform scans on planets. [[Deeve]], of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]], used one of these, along with other items, while on a mission.<ref name="Survey" />
